findings.body:
**Correct the pricing note: drivers price the served model ID, not the requested one.**

`PROVENANCE.md` says the retained behavior prices `deepseek-chat` requests through their own direct key. The ai-sdk and acp drivers instead price the served model ID when the wire reports one. A `deepseek-chat` request served as `deepseek-flash` is therefore priced at the `deepseek-flash` rate (0.15 / 0.6 / 0.003), not the `deepseek-chat` rate (0.28 / 0.42 / 0.028). The note does not describe this path.

The served-ID pricing appears to be intentional. The code comments describe the served model as the reported identity, and the lookup itself is unchanged. The repository does not show which rate the provider bills, so this note does not establish that reported cost is wrong. Only the description of the pricing behavior needs correction.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-   declared alias set. Retained behavior, which is what prices them today: both
-   ids are direct keys in `./data.ts`, and `priceOf` prices each by exact
-   provider-handle + model-id match, never through a fabricated rate.
+   declared alias set. Current behavior: both ids are direct keys in `./data.ts`,
+   and `priceOf` prices each by exact provider-handle + model-id match, never
+   through a fabricated rate. The ai-sdk and acp drivers pass the served model ID
+   to the pricing lookup when the wire reports one. A `deepseek-chat` request
+   served as `deepseek-flash` is therefore priced at the `deepseek-flash` rate,
+   not the `deepseek-chat` rate.
```

</details>
